results.title: Functional Medicine Cost Broken Down by Texas Telemedicine Practice
results.description: Functional medicine cost at a Texas telemedicine practice typically runs $1,750 to $4,250. The breakdown covers $1,250 in fixed fees for two doctor-led appointments, lab testing from $500 to $3,000, and roughly 4 to 8.5 hours of professional time on each case.
